field.label: Enable
field.help: Turn the Session Border Controller on. In this development build nothing acts on the settings yet; they are saved for the next features.

field.label: External interface
field.help: Where SIP trunks and remote phones reach the SBC, usually WAN.

field.label: Internal interface
field.help: Where the PBX sits, usually LAN. The PBX is never exposed on the external interface.

field.label: SIP port
field.help: Port for SIP signalling on both interfaces. 5060 is the standard.

field.label: First media port
field.help: Start of the UDP range used to relay call audio. Each call takes a pair of ports only while it is up (ADR-SBC-0003).

field.label: Last media port
field.help: End of the media range. Two ports per call: 10000 to 20000 allows about 5000 calls.
